title: Nameled Camilla
author: Pesterox
description:

A unique and original lamp featuring the name **Camilla** in a fun 3D design.

Perfect as a personalized gift, decoration for a bedroom, office, or any space that deserves a creative and luminous touch.

🔹 Modern and playful design

🔹 Bold 3D-style letters

🔹 Great gift idea for birthdays, special occasions, or simply to make your space truly unique

This lamp is not just a decorative piece – it’s a bright way to bring a name to life!

💡 **Important note:**

No holes have been made for the LED strip cable. This way, everyone has the freedom to decide how to light up the inside of the lamp and where to route the cable, fully customizing it to their needs.
